== Summary ==
A framed Players Committee poster at the venue of the [[2009 World Championship]], October 2009. The poster: "Sorry if they're a little fuzzy. The lighting was terrible".

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by Cloudburst: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=471032#p471032 post 471032], "Pics [Worlds 09]" (topic 31192), 14 October 2009. Photobucket album themanwhowasdumb, image IMG_1695-1.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261126023047/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/e/e5/2009_World_Championship_Players_Committee_poster.jpg Internet Archive].
